title: 관객

title: 감정들

title: 그건
sp: K-Hip Hop with a boom bap influence. Amapiano track featuring a log drum bassline and syncopated percussion. The production features a prominent, funky electric bassline playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. bright brass stabs, slap bass, clean funk guitar, punchy drums. The vocal delivery is rhythmic and aggressive with rapid-fire Korean and English phrasing. Minimalist percussion featuring a soft kick drum on the downbeat and subtle shaker. A steady, mechanical metronome-like click or woodblock sound provides a rhythmic pulse at 72 BPM in 4/4 time.
